comments.author: @EnlightenedCarnivore
comments.text: In 2018 I found a book that explained that humans are predominantly meat eaters. That the only reason for a human to eat plants are for survival in times of no meat. Since 2022 I haven't eaten any plants, or foods made with plants. I no longer wear shoes (I go barefoot, I live in the tropics). I haven't brushed my teeth in upwards of two years. I'm 65 years old and I'm optimally healthy and very happy. To be clear; I live in the modern world with modern technologies, and I love it. But, whenever I can, I live like NATURAL humans have evolved to live. I'm so glad to have found this video, it's living proof of a lifestyle I imagined hasn't existed for, say, 30 or 40 thousand years. This is a rambling, babbling way of saying Thanks, TOUR GUIDE, for yet another virtual travel video. 🤭 ✨💖✨
